subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Uses capital letters, full stops, commas, question marks, exclamation marks and inverted commas correctly

show.line: Inverted commas hold the words someone says. Mama said, "Come and eat." Only the spoken words go inside!

rounds.prompt: Which sentence shows that Sipho is talking?
rounds.praise: Yes! His words are inside inverted commas.

rounds.prompt: Which words did the girl say? Tap the part inside the inverted commas.
rounds.praise: Yes! Hello Gogo is what she said.

rounds.prompt: Look at the speech bubble. What does the boy say? Read it.
Where do the inverted commas go?
rounds.praise: Yes! Around the spoken words only.

rounds.prompt: Which mark goes after Mama said, before the spoken words?
Someone talking, or no one talking? Sort the sentences.

hints: Inverted commas go around the exact words someone says.
Find the speech bubble words. Those go inside.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will write what Thabo said.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I put inverted commas around Thabo said!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Only the words Thabo spoke go inside the inverted commas.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's find the spoken words together. I am tired. Those go inside!

parent_line: Can spot and use inverted commas around spoken words.
